'''MSE-6-PR2''' was an [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6 series repair droid]] that had somehow wound up on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] with a crate of similar droids during the [[Galactic War]]. It requested help from an individual in recovering data from the wreck of the ''[[Sendant Pride]]''.<ref name="Encounter" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' {{1st}}
